summary: Verified the jira-clone journey in the browser on both lanes and measured every fact the cell needs (seven style probes identical across lanes, exact seam inventory, drag/modal/create/filter selectors, scroll absence, seed-board restore). Three spec contradictions surfaced: create-issue is navbar item :nth-of-type(3) (item 2 is a search drawer whose overlay hangs the journey), one Backspace does not widen the filter, and the reload cancels a third Sentry envelope POST whose failure the generic inventory would record by full URL including the DSN public key. Wrote no repository files; the remaining work also exceeds one unit.
open_questions: The reload aborts an in-flight Sentry envelope POST (net::ERR_ABORTED) even with the 200 application/json {} answer. The generic tallyFailedRequests records non-loopback failures by full URL including the sentry_key query, leaking the DSN, and the count is load-timing dependent so it cannot be pinned exactly. Authorise one of: (a) a generic AppSpec redactFailedRequestPath hook so the pinned entry carries no query, (b) admitting it through the corroborated cancelled-duplicate-fetch category (two 200 siblings of the same method/path exist in-run), or (c) dropping the reload, which would also drop the after-online-reload zero-service-worker checkpoint.

Journey (d): typing 'Witness' narrows the board to 1/0/0/0, but a single Backspace leaves it narrowed because 'Witnes' still matches. Confirm the widening gesture: clear the field entirely (select-all + Backspace), click the app's own 'Clear all' control, or assert narrowing only.

Re-cut needed: the remaining work is the AppSpec plus four journeys, renderedStyles wiring through executeRun and runReactBaselineDifferentialProfile, a ~700-line core schema, the runner, and two test files. Split into (1) core schema plus real-app-run wiring and (2) journey plus runner plus tests.
